title: Check any broker in 4 steps
caption:
Check any broker in 4 steps: search the name, confirm the licence on the regulator's own register, check the Trust Score and reviews, then compare.

Before you fund an account properly, deposit small and test a withdrawal. Save this for the next time someone sends you a 'great broker'.

topic: Easy to deposit. Hard to withdraw?
title: Easy to deposit. Hard to withdraw?
caption:
Deposits are instant. Withdrawals are where brokers show who they are. Delays, extra documents, "bonus terms" that lock your balance. Read the withdrawal reviews first.

Research only, not financial advice.

title: A licence badge proves nothing.
caption:
A regulator's logo on a website is an image. Anyone can paste one. The only proof is the regulator's own register, and it takes two minutes to search.

Research only, not financial advice.

topic: How a Trust Score is built
title: How a Trust Score is built
caption:
What's inside a Trust Score? Five factors: regulation, reviews, transparency, footprint and complaints. The formula and weights are published on our methodology page, and no broker can pay to move up.

A score is where your research starts, not a recommendation.
